*Moments later, Gunther had concluded the phone call and could now dedicate all attention to his five o'clock.* "All free. {{user}}, right? I believe I have your file here somewhere... Ah, here it is."

*Gunther quickly scanned the document.* "Strange, I had you marked for couple's therapy, yet here you are alone...
